Name: Simple Money Ledger
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b][color=#F2C879]✦ Simple Money Ledger ✦[/color][/b][/size][/center]

[b]Keep track of where your gold comes from — and where it goes.[/b]
A Stardew-style account book for your [b]actual gold income and spending[/b]. Read your transactions in Book view or a compact Bank dashboard, find an item or purchase, and check your totals without changing the farm’s economy.
Desktop 1.5 • Soft Vanilla & Dim Soft Vanilla • Keyboard and controller support • 12 languages
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]📖 Your account book[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509581-779529665.png[/img][/center]
[b]Book view:[/b] a curved account book with your balance, summaries, filters and transaction history. Wider windows use two pages; compact windows use one.
Click the [b]HUD gold display[/b] during normal gameplay to open the ledger. Select a transaction for its details, use search to find an item, source or location, and choose filters from proper dropdown lists.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509595-528454408.png[/img][/center]
Actual gold changes are recorded. Unknown sources are labelled honestly.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🏦 A Bank dashboard for the same history[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509618-326532954.png[/img][/center]
[b]Bank dashboard:[/b] compact rows with separate income, expenses and resulting balance. Wider screens add date, source and location columns, category spending and daily totals.
Choose [b]Bank view[/b] from the cog’s View dropdown. Your choice is remembered per farmer. Both views share the same records and retain your current filters and scroll position where possible.
Use [b]Account overview[/b] for the complete category and daily reports, largest income and largest expense. Summary totals follow the selected period; search, direction and category filters narrow the transaction list.
Bank view is an informational dashboard. It does not add deposits, withdrawals, loans or interest.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🎨 Soft Vanilla, with a gentler Dim option[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509628-211937894.png[/img][/center]
[b]Dim Soft Vanilla:[/b] noticeably darker warm brown parchment, dark brown lettering and clear income/expense colours. Gold scrollbars, arrows and native item artwork remain.
[b]Soft Vanilla[/b] is the normal appearance. Turn on [b]Dim Mode[/b] for the deeper warm brown paper. It starts off and affects only this ledger’s pages, panels, settings, details and dropdowns.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]⚙ Familiar settings[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509643-1383090762.png[/img][/center]
[b]Top-right cog:[/b] switch Book/Bank, toggle Dim Mode, check your current opening binding and read wallet/history information. Long settings pages scroll.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509653-1241445947.png[/img][/center]
The cog saves view and Dim changes immediately. GMCM retains Save, Cancel and Reset.
Dim Mode changes only ledger colours. It does not change your money or other menus.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is [b]optional[/b]. Use it to assign keyboard/controller opening bindings and adjust click access, smooth scrolling or Dim Mode. HUD clicking and the cog work without GMCM.
[b]Optional GMCM:[/b] Click gold On, Open ledger unassigned, Smooth scrolling On and Dim Mode Off. Existing configured opening bindings are preserved.
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509677-723722972.png[/img][/center]
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🔎 Details you can read[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509683-671301465.png[/img][/center]

[b]Transaction details:[/b] inspect the signed amount, known source, item and quantity, date/time, location and resulting balance. Item names and sprites come from loaded game data.
Known sources include shop purchases and sales, tool upgrades, geode processing, construction, animal purchases, native quest rewards, mail money and selected travel/services. Item icons and quantities appear when the source can be identified reliably.
Unknown causes are shown as [b]Money received[/b] or [b]Money spent[/b], with [b]Source not recorded[/b] and [b]Uncategorized[/b] where appropriate. The ledger keeps the actual amount without guessing where it came from.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]🎮 Compact layouts and controls[/color][/heading]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509697-555650618.png[/img][/center]
[b]Compact layout:[/b] one readable Book page with scrollable history. Menus reflow for the game viewport and UI scale.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53620/53620-1791509768-67706033.png[/img][/center]
The optional opening hotkey starts unassigned. Set your own binding in GMCM.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]🧾 What the history records[/color][/heading]
[quote][b]Starts when you add the mod[/b]
Recording begins after installation/load. Earlier transactions and changes made while a player was disconnected cannot be reconstructed. Your current balance is used as the starting point; it is not invented income.[/quote]
[quote][b]Gold only[/b]
Tracks changes to native gold. Qi gems, casino coins, star tokens, barters and ingredient costs are outside this ledger. Shipping appears when the combined payment is credited overnight, rather than as fictional individual item sales.[/quote]
[quote][b]Per-farmer records and wallets[/b]
Each farmer keeps their own observed history, with shared and personal wallet records kept distinct. Remote shared-wallet changes may arrive grouped, without the original shop, item or time. Player records are not merged into a synchronized farm audit.[/quote]
[quote][b]Your money stays yours[/b]
The ledger does not change gold, prices, rewards, inventory or progression. Existing history is retained on update. If stored history cannot be read, it is preserved rather than silently overwritten.[/quote]
[heading][color=#9ACAF7]🧩 Compatibility and languages[/color][/heading]

Built for [b]desktop Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] with [b]SMAPI 4.4.0 or later[/b]. No other Simple mod is required. GMCM is optional. Android compatibility has not been established for this release.
Loaded borders, scroll sprites and item artwork remain available to texture replacements; ledger paper stays in its chosen warm palette. A mod that completely replaces the HUD gold display may require the configured opening hotkey. Systems that never change native gold cannot be observed.
[heading][color=#C8B0F4]🌍 Languages[/color][/heading]
English, French, German, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Turkish and Hungarian. The interface follows the game’s language.
Checked with isolated native menus and recording/input fixtures. Complete modpack sessions, multiplayer, split-screen and physical-controller play still need in-game testing. Interface pictures on this page are native-renderer previews with illustrative transactions.

[heading][color=#C8B0F4]📥 Installation[/color][/heading]

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] if needed.
2. Extract the [b]SimpleMoneyLedger[/b] folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
3. Launch through SMAPI and click the HUD gold display. To use an opening shortcut, assign it through optional GMCM.
When updating, replace the mod files and retain your existing config.json. No save reset is needed. To remove the mod, remove its folder; its saved ledger data can remain harmlessly in the save.
[heading][color=#8FDAC0]💬 Need help?[/color][/heading]
Include your SMAPI log, mod version, game/UI scale and the action that triggered the problem. For missing sources, mention which mod or purchase changed the balance. This helps distinguish an unrecognized source from a missed gold change.
